title: Simple presheaf maps and labelled inner-anodyne classes
statement: Use the small coefficient universe and containing ambient universe, monoidal cartesian presentation $p:C_\otimes\to\Delta$, normalized Yoneda functor, presheaves and restriction $p^*$ of [def-coef-segal-presheaf-localization]. Use coherent diagrams, functor categories, simplicial nerves, and colimits from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], ordinal diagrams and their specified coherent cocones as in [lem-coef-finite-reedy-localization], discrete spaces as in [lem-coef-discrete-weight-coherent-cocones], and the specified-cone homotopy pullback convention of [def-coef-space-base-change] (the latter square construction applies in any quasicategory). Write $\operatorname{Arr}(\mathscr C)=\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathscr C)$. A retract of an object is witnessed by arrows $a\to b\to a$ and a compositional triangle whose long edge is the identity of $a$; apply this in $\operatorname{Arr}(\mathscr C)$ for arrow retracts. A homotopy pushout is a coherent square whose restriction from its outgoing span is a left Kan extension. A weakly saturated class of arrows contains equivalences and is closed under homotopy pushouts, small continuous transfinite compositions (including length zero) and retracts in the coherent arrow category; its generated closure is the intersection of all such classes containing the generators. Regard a simplicial set as a presheaf on $\Delta$ of discrete spaces, on all arrows as well as objects. Let $p_!$ be a left adjoint of actual restriction, with its coherent unit, counit and mapping-space universal properties. For an arrow $r:Y\to p^*T$, its adjoint is the composite $p_!Y\xrightarrow{p_!r}p_!p^*T\xrightarrow{\epsilon_T}T$, with its compositional triangle. A presheaf is representable if it is equivalent to the normalized Yoneda image of an object. For $L\in P(\Delta)$, an arrow $f:X\to p^*L$ is simple if for every $n\geq0$ and every $\sigma:\Delta^n\to L$, the homotopy pullback exists, and for every such pullback $X_\sigma$ the presheaf $X_\sigma$ is representable and the adjoint of its actual projection $X_\sigma\to p^*\Delta^n$ is an equivalence. Write $\mathcal A_\Delta$ for the weak saturation of the discrete inner horn inclusions $\Lambda_b^n\to\Delta^n$, $n\geq2$, $0<b<n$. Write $\mathcal A_C$ for the weak saturation of the projections from the homotopy pullbacks $\Delta^n(\boldsymbol c)\times_{p^*\Delta^n}p^*\Lambda_b^n\to\Delta^n(\boldsymbol c)$, for labels in the fibre of $p$ over $[n]$. The structural map $\Delta^n(\boldsymbol c)\to p^*\Delta^n$ is characterized by requiring its adjunct to be an equivalence: $p_!\Delta^n(\boldsymbol c)\simeq\Delta^n$ and the only order automorphism of $[n]$ is the identity. All choices of homotopy pullback squares give the same generated class.
